body: Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-23, caught before any run). `engram add` (filing a new item) MOVES the session's focus to the new item (focus_change in the reply), even though it is unclaimed. Turn credit binds to the focus at turn start, so filing a follow-up while you wait for a run slot can make your next focused run count for the wrong item. Right after any add, re-claim your working item (`engram work claim <ref>`, a same-holder renewal) and check that focus_change points back to it, before the next run. Related: bara1-note-on-other-item-moves-focus.
